probes.summary: A call returns without a panic.
probes.vacuous: Never, because every call either returns or panics.

probes.summary: A call with a cancelled context returns an error.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe cancels the context itself.

probes.summary: A call that fails returns the zero value of its result.
probes.vacuous: No call fails, with the sample inputs or with a cancelled context.

probes.summary: A call that fails returns the zero value of each of its two results.
probes.vacuous: No call fails, with the sample inputs or with a cancelled context.

probes.summary: A call that returns a false presence flag returns the zero value of its result.
probes.vacuous: The call returns a true presence flag for an input that nothing stored.

probes.summary: A call that returns a false presence flag returns the zero value of each of its two results.
probes.vacuous: The call returns a true presence flag for an input that nothing stored.

probes.summary: A read of an input that nothing stored returns nil.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the subject is fresh and nothing stored the input.

probes.summary: A read of an input that nothing stored returns the zero value.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the subject is fresh and nothing stored the input.

probes.summary: Two calls with the same inputs return the same value.
probes.vacuous: The first call fails.

probes.summary: A second call returns without a panic after a first call.
probes.vacuous: The first call panics, which is the failure of the check of a single call.

probes.summary: A read of an input that nothing stored fails with the declared sentinel.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the subject is fresh and nothing stored the input.

probes.summary: A second identical call succeeds after a first call that succeeded.
probes.vacuous: The first call fails.

probes.summary: A read after a write returns the value of the write.
probes.vacuous: The write fails.

probes.summary: Two reads of one snapshot return the same value across a write between them.
probes.vacuous: The first read or the write fails.

probes.summary: One drain after two writes returns each element at most once.
probes.vacuous: The drain returns fewer than two elements.

probes.summary: Two drains after two writes return the elements in the same order.
probes.vacuous: The first drain returns fewer than two elements.

probes.summary: A drain gains exactly the elements that two writes wrote since the drain before it.
probes.vacuous: A write fails.

probes.summary: A drain gains at least the elements that two writes wrote since the drain before it.
probes.vacuous: A write fails.

probes.summary: The second result of a call is at least the first.
probes.vacuous: The first call fails.

probes.summary: A second read after a write returns a version that is at least the version of the first read.
probes.vacuous: The write or the first read fails.

probes.summary: A write after a read has a version above the version that the read returned.
probes.vacuous: The first write or the read fails.

probes.summary: A call with the declared unsafe value returns an output that does not contain it.
probes.vacuous: The call fails.

probes.summary: A call with the declared input at the edge of the domain succeeds.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the input is the declared edge.

probes.summary: A call with the value that the declared validator refuses fails.
probes.vacuous: The validator accepts the declared invalid value.

probes.summary: A call after the close fails with the declared sentinel.
probes.vacuous: The close fails.

probes.summary: A call on a fresh subject, before its declared predecessor, fails with the declared sentinel.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the subject is fresh and the predecessor has not run.

probes.summary: A call after its declared predecessor succeeds.
probes.vacuous: The predecessor fails.

probes.summary: The named observation changes after a call and the settle that follows it.
probes.vacuous: The call or the settle fails.

probes.summary: A call returns before the clock of the run passes its declared budget.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe advances the clock past the budget.

probes.summary: A count includes an occurrence inside the declared window and not after it.
probes.vacuous: The call fails.

probes.summary: A registered task has not run halfway to its instant and has run once the clock passes it.
probes.vacuous: The registration fails.

probes.summary: A result changes once the clock moves in doubling steps far enough.
probes.vacuous: The establishing write or the first call fails.

probes.summary: Two calls return the same value while the clock does not move.
probes.vacuous: The establishing write or the first call fails.

probes.summary: A read of a written entry fails with the declared sentinel once the clock passes its lifetime.
probes.vacuous: The write fails, or the read fails before the clock moves.

probes.summary: A read of a written key fails with the declared sentinel after its delete.
probes.vacuous: The write or the delete fails.

probes.summary: The named observation changes after a call.
probes.vacuous: The call fails.

probes.summary: Each call after the induced failure fails.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe induces the failure itself.

probes.summary: The verify of a value fails after its tamper.
probes.vacuous: The call fails, or the verify fails before the tamper.

probes.summary: A call inside an open transaction succeeds within the declared attempts.
probes.vacuous: The begin fails.

probes.summary: A call succeeds within the declared attempts.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe makes every attempt.

probes.summary: A call runs the hook that the registrar installed before it.
probes.vacuous: The registrar or the call fails.

probes.summary: Each of two calls changes the named observation.
probes.vacuous: A call fails.

probes.summary: A read in one partition after writes in two partitions returns the value of its own partition.
probes.vacuous: A write fails.

probes.summary: The replay after two appends returns the entries in the order of their stamps.
probes.vacuous: An append fails.

probes.summary: The replay after an admitted append has one entry more than the replay before it.
probes.vacuous: The append fails, or the replay fails before it.

probes.summary: The second of two appends returns a position above the first.
probes.vacuous: The first append fails.

probes.summary: The inverse returns the value that went into the forward call.
probes.vacuous: The forward call fails.

probes.summary: A second write meets the condition that the first write established and fails with the declared sentinel.
probes.vacuous: The first write fails.

probes.summary: A write of a value that the predicate rejects fails.
probes.vacuous: The predicate accepts both values.

probes.summary: A second settlement or a call after the close of a handle fails with the declared sentinel.
probes.vacuous: The call opens no handle, or the close fails.

probes.summary: A call after the declared burst fails with the declared sentinel.
probes.vacuous: A call inside the burst fails.

probes.summary: The leadership read reports no leadership after a campaign and its resign.
probes.vacuous: The campaign or the resign fails.

probes.summary: A read after a scope whose body wrote and then failed fails with the declared sentinel.
probes.vacuous: The scope does not run its body, or the write inside it fails.

probes.summary: The cache returns the value that its backing returns, after an establishing write.
probes.vacuous: The establishing write or the read of the backing fails.

probes.summary: The put accepts the value that the get lent.
probes.vacuous: The get lends nothing.

probes.summary: A read with the cursor of the first page returns another page.
probes.vacuous: The first page returns no cursor.

probes.summary: The compensation accepts the step that the call applied.
probes.vacuous: The step fails.

probes.summary: The reader finds nothing after a write of the declared refused value fails.
probes.vacuous: The write of the refused value succeeds.

probes.summary: A read after two writes for one key returns the value of the second write.
probes.vacuous: A write fails.

probes.summary: The list of the variants contains each variant once, in the order of the declaration.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe compares the whole list.

probes.summary: Each variant renders its declared text, and no two variants and no value outside them render one text.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe renders every variant.

probes.summary: Each variant is valid, and a value outside the variants is not.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe judges every variant.

probes.summary: The text of each variant parses to the variant, and the text of no variant fails with the error of the parse function.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe parses the text of every variant.

probes.summary: Each variant encodes its own text.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe encodes every variant.

probes.summary: The text of each variant decodes to the variant, and the text of no variant fails to decode.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe decodes the text of every variant.

probes.summary: Each error value has a message with the opening, and no message equals or opens with the whole message of another.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe reads every error value.

probes.summary: No error value matches another error value of the package or of a package under no-overlap-with.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe compares every pair of error values.

probes.summary: The message of a value of each error type opens with the opening and contains each member of text.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe reads a value of every error type.

probes.summary: The hook Is of an error type that compares itself agrees with the identity of the language on each error value.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the gate selects a type that compares itself.

probes.summary: An error type with a cause returns the cause that the check gives it.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the gate selects a type with a cause.

probes.summary: No value of an error type matches another error type of the package.
probes.vacuous: Never, because the probe compares every pair of error types.
